hypothesis: W-R24 exposed failure of same-index temporal matching under order-preserving retiming. A bounded monotone dynamic-programming alignment between only observed four-channel sequences may allow a fixed-width learner to distinguish positive monotone warps from true negative local swaps.
freeze: Predefine both model feature arms, DP recurrence/tie and gap penalty, training budget, input generator, warp maps, erasure coding, split and success classifications before original first-use. No post-result selection.
source: Original Wingless four-channel 16-tick affine synthetic sequence with genuine time-varying jitter. Heldout also tests frozen quadratic and xorshift generators; positive label iff candidate has not undergone the local swap.
training: Both arms train with identical development seeds, 9 entities, 3 local swap positions2/3,5/6,8/9, amplitude1/2, positive/negative labels, deterministic erasure mask counts0/2/4, original identity time index mapping; exactly 1728 paired cases/arm, 16 weights+bias, zero init, 32 perceptron passes and LR .1.
heldout: Unseen heldout seeds320-335, 3 generators, monotone warp maps identity,one duplicate at6,two duplicates at5/6, candidate noise amplitude3 and erasure mask counts3/5, 2 unseen local swaps10/11 and12/13, 18 cells per arm.
arm1: Same original W-R22 maskaware four-channel top-two consecutive transition feature; 16 repeated scalar features
arm2: 16 repeated scalar of bounded monotone dynamic-programming alignment cost. Align original and non-erased candidate rows by anchor-relative per-channel circular distance; path transitions diagonal/up/left, fixed 0.10 skip penalty on up/left, strict |reference index - original candidate tick index|<=2 corridor, normalize final cost by 16. 16x16 bounded DP; no separate missingness oracle, detect only observed all-zero candidate rows.
primary: MONOTONE_ALIGNMENT_TRANSFER if aligned arm >=0.80 accuracy in each 12 warped heldout cells and exceeds baseline mean warped accuracy by >=0.10; PARTIAL if aligned warped average exceeds baseline by >=0.05 without strict success; NEGATIVE otherwise. Include confusion by seed and all failures.
controls: Exact 16 learned weights+bias and 1728 examples/32 epochs per arm, but alignment DP adds explicit bounded feature-computation cost, not claimed compute parity
No labels, attention or future-state oracle; row erasure explicitly encoded
Every negative swaps only two observable unmasked candidate rows, positive and negative candidate multiset/anchor identical
No exposed W-R24 holdout use, no rerun, original artifact before one full Go integration regression
claim_limit: Synthetic short-sequence alignment pilot; neither language reasoning nor autonomous cognitive transfer.
